display_description: Skip the right-click menu in bank and crafting interfaces — configure left-click to do a chosen amount.
Drop an inventory item with a single configurable click (left, right, or shift) instead of the right-click menu.
Mark tiles in the world with a colored border and label via shift + right-click. Includes a built-in T3 Maps preset.
Split chat into tabs (All, Local, Global, System, Private) with unread counts, ignore/block/alert-word filters, custom colours, and adjustable size.
A trading card game for High Spell: earn credits by playing, open packs, and collect cards for every item and creature in the game.
